title: Map bundle manifest
description: Metadata for a map data bundle (PMTiles + Photon index + Valhalla tiles). Region name lives inside this file, not in any filesystem path.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump when the manifest shape changes in a way that breaks parsers.

region.description: Region identifier matching the YAML filename in build/maps/regions/ (e.g. north-america, united-states, europe, california, japan). Consumed by UI for display and mismatch detection, never by scripts to compute a filesystem path.

region_display_name.description: Human-friendly label shown in the PWA (e.g. "North America").

build_date.description: UTC timestamp of when the build script finished, RFC 3339.

pbf_date.description: Date of the underlying OSM PBF extract used as source. Users can tell how fresh the map data is.

odbl_notice.description: Attribution + license notice for the OSM-derived data content. Included in the bundle so downstream consumers see it inside the artifact, not just in the repo.

build_tool_versions.description: Optional: versions of the build-time tools that produced this bundle. Aids reproducibility and debugging.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file as it sits inside the bundle zip.

bytes.description: Uncompressed byte size of the file inside the bundle.
